market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH trades near $2,300 May 2 2026. Hitting $1,500 requires a ~35% drawdown by year-end. Near-term derivatives show negative funding/sentiment, but historical May average is positive. Crypto bear-market drawdowns of that magnitude over 8 months are possible but not base-rate (~25-30%) given current macro/inflation concerns.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shock or crypto-specific de-risking event over remaining 8 months
